# Using Python in Web Pages

This page was created following the guidelines from [UBC MDS DSCI 521 milestone3](https://ubc-mds.github.io/DSCI_521_platforms-dsci/assignments/milestone3.html). 

## Dataset

We use the dataset from  [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) to test how to embed python code and output into html page via Quarto. The dataset is loaded via python package palmerpenguins. 


## Python code

First step, we load the pengiuin data set and check what it has. 

```{python}
#| echo: true    
#| output: true  
#| eval: true   

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
from IPython.display import display
penguins = load_penguins()
display(penguins.describe())
print("\n")
display(penguins.head())
```

calculate the average bill length (mm) of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen island. 

```{python}
pats = penguins.query("species == 'Adelie' and island == 'Torgersen'" )
bill_length_mean = pats['bill_length_mm'].mean()
```

The average bill length of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen is `{python} f"{bill_length_mean:.0f} mm."`

## Dataset

[palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) dataset(CC0 1.0)  AM, Hill AP, Gorman KB (2020). palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data.
